name: Calendar
description: A calendar of the Calendar library app (forge 28e): a person's own, a team's (no owner) or a room's, native or mirrored from an outside calendar through a connection. Who may see and change it is its grants: whoever made it holds Calendar writer on it, and sharing grants writer, reader or free/busy (calendar.share).

fields.name: Colour
fields.description: A theme palette name (primary, secondary, success, warning, error, info) or a CSS colour

fields.name: Time zone
fields.description: The IANA zone its events are made in by default, e.g. Europe/London

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: Whose calendar it is; none for a team calendar or a room

fields.name: Room
fields.description: A room: a team calendar people book

fields.name: Connection
fields.description: The outside calendar's connection (calendar.events@1); empty for a native calendar

fields.name: Outside id
fields.description: The calendar's id at the outside service

fields.name: Window from
fields.description: The first day mirrored and expanded; 90 days back when empty

fields.name: Window to
fields.description: The day after the last mirrored and expanded; a year ahead when empty

fields.name: Shared with
fields.description: Who it is shared with and how: [{user, level}], level freeBusy, read or write (calendar.share keeps it, and the grants follow it)

access.read: principal.kind == 'app' || principal.owner || record.owner == principal.user || principal.hasRole('calWriter', record._id) || principal.hasRole('calReader', record._id) || principal.hasRole('calFreeBusy', record._id)
